task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer is launched and a DICOM image from the samples directory is loaded into the viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible with a medical scan (CT or MR) displayed in the central viewing area.

task_completion.description: The contrast of the DICOM image has been inverted (Photometric Interpretation change).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image appears as a 'negative'; typically, bones or dense structures that were white are now black, and the background is light/white.

task_completion.description: A line measurement tool has been used to draw a measurement across a structure in the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A graphical line overlay is visible on the DICOM image, accompanied by a numeric value and unit (e.g., mm or cm).

task_completion.description: The agent navigates the export menu to save the current view as a JPEG named lecture_slide.jpg.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or file explorer window shows the path ~/DICOM/exports/lecture_slide.jpg being entered or saved.

task_completion.description: A text file is created containing the exact measured length and unit from the GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command shows the creation of measurement.txt with the content 'Measured Length: <value> <unit>' matching the GUI measurement.

integrity.description: The measurement was performed using the Weasis GUI tools, not simulated.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the measurement toolbar icon and dragging the line across the anatomy.

integrity.description: The inversion was applied via the software's image processing tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Invert' button in the Weasis 'Display' or 'Image Tool' panel is highlighted or toggled.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move a pre-existing result file into the export folder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the active process of drawing the line and using the 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog within Weasis.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses real CT/MR DICOM samples. The final output must be a JPEG at ~/DICOM/exports/lecture_slide.jpg showing an inverted (negative) image with a visible measurement line. The text file ~/DICOM/exports/measurement.txt must contain the string 'Measured Length: ' followed by the exact numeric value and unit seen in the Weasis GUI measurement overlay.
